latestTerminalSummary:
My Round 22 review is a **fail** against the all-twelve-at-least-9 target: three categories score 8.5 in both light and dark. Report: `docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo/round-22-opus-visual.md`.

| Category | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| Typography | 9 | 9 |
| Composition and spacing | **8.5** | **8.5** |
| Color harmony | 9 | 9 |
| Contrast and emphasis | 9 | 9 |
| Component visual consistency | **8.5** | **8.5** |
| Responsive visual polish | **8.5** | **8.5** |

**Both Round 22 fixes work, checked live in my own tab:**
- **Share opens at its top.** At 320×640 (light and dark), 390×640 and 640×360, the sheet opens with no scroll offset and focus on Close.
- **Reopening is also clean.** After scrolling to the bottom, closing with Done and reopening, it is back at the top.
- **Editor help text is fixed.** It now uses the shared size and line height, with 12px between paragraphs.

**What holds three categories at 8.5:** expanding the editor's Stored state, Stored assets and Gallery widget sections shows they still don't follow the rules the rest of the app uses.
- **Notes glued to buttons:** the Export/Import notes start 0px below their button rows at 1280, so the text touches the buttons. The widget help also sits 0px under the tile, with about 35px of space below it.
- **A loud delete button:** "Erase all data" is solid red, right next to two filled blue buttons. Every other destructive action is quiet: Settings uses a soft red, and the editor Delete and tag Delete use outlines.
- **Short buttons on phones:** at 320 the editor's Stored state, Stored assets and widget buttons are 36px tall. Other buttons on the same page (Add key, View/Restore, Return to Library, Delete) are 44px.
- **Uneven data-inspector buttons:** Move up/down are 28px wide beside 40px Remove buttons, and one "Remove property" button sits beside its label instead of at the right edge.

**Fix to reach 9:**
- Give help text that follows a control an 8–12px gap above it.
- Make Erase all data a soft or outline red button.
- Use the 44px phone height for editor panel buttons.
- Make the inspector icon buttons one size and right-align them.

None of this adds features or decoration.

**Limits:** a single Chromium engine with emulated viewports. The 36px phone height was measured in dark only; light is inferred from the same button style. I didn't re-check Tags, Filters, the viewer receipt, URL/Paste add modes, autocomplete, or Share at 1280 this round. I made no saves or other changes; `round-22-opus-visual.md` is the only file I wrote. This one report can't establish a joint pass.
